diagnostic_method: Read-only inspection of the failed run and static comparison against Git baseline d7d2061; no additional Editor run or build.

assertions: add geographic waypoint: not in edit mode (three occurrences)
failure_groups.cause: The fixture submits UAV-9011 selection and enters the legacy path editor within the same latent-command update, before the authoritative selection ACK. The editor therefore begins with zero paths.

runtime_sequence.event: Path editor reports Begin edit mode with 0 path(s).
Primary selection changes to UAV-9011 and the remote selection is applied after editor entry.

source_evidence: Source/UE5DroneControl/Tests/CommandMapModeTest.cpp:104-106 submits selection without waiting for ACK; line 127 begins planning in the same update.
Source/UE5DroneControl/DroneOps/Core/DroneRegistrySubsystem.cpp:472-496 routes selection through OperationalContext and returns before ACK.
Source/UE5DroneControl/UI/SequenceDispatchPanelWidget.cpp:1383 collects the currently accepted selection before invoking BeginPathEditMode.
Source/UE5DroneControl/DroneOps/Control/DroneOpsPlayerController.cpp:3306-3399 permits editor entry with zero paths and reports the path count.
Source/UE5DroneControl/DroneOps/Control/DroneOpsPlayerController.cpp:1994 reports the same not-in-edit-mode message when EditingPaths is empty; it does not prove the edit-mode boolean was false.
Source/UE5DroneControl/UI/SequenceDispatchPanelWidget.cpp:1467 rejects confirmation when the generated path collection is empty, preventing the popup and playback.

failure_groups.cause: The fixture registers UAV-9011 and its sender actor but supplies neither accepted GPS telemetry nor a Mock home/execution position for that ID. The existing FocusAlertOnMap to FocusDrone path requires MapMove::Position and does not substitute the sender actor's transform for an accepted aircraft position.
source_evidence: Source/UE5DroneControl/Tests/CommandMapModeTest.cpp:103-106 creates the registered actor fixture without supplying accepted position data.
Source/UE5DroneControl/Command/CommandMapInteractionService.cpp:342-353 resolves the alert and delegates to SelectDrone and FocusDrone.
Source/UE5DroneControl/Map/MapMoveSupport.h:Position accepts valid telemetry or an allowed acknowledged Mock position; actor existence alone is insufficient.

baseline_comparison.focus_drone_difference: This change adds an optional bFrameClose parameter and a conditional near-view distance assignment. The A2 caller uses the false default, so that new assignment is not executed. The accepted-position guard is unchanged from the baseline.
baseline_comparison.startup_exclusion_evidence: The run explicitly entered 2D before the failing workflow; its recorded fixture coordinates remained in Beijing, and no MapStartup origin-application event was present. The offline QA startup-origin gate was active.
baseline_comparison.conclusion: The observed failure mechanisms are pre-existing fixture assumptions and unchanged call-chain behavior. The legacy entry points remain present; the evidence does not show this migration disabling a previously valid route editor.

limitations: The old d7d2061 DLL was not executed for a runtime A/B comparison. Static equivalence and the current run's ordering evidence do not constitute a completed baseline execution.
This diagnostic does not turn A2MapMode into a passing test or establish successful legacy playback.

The original raw log contains provider credential-bearing URLs. This JSON intentionally includes no such URLs or credentials; any publication of the original report requires the repository's sanitization process.

disposition.reason: The seven failures are attributable to the old A2 fixture's missing selection-ACK wait and accepted-position setup, not to the startup-view and layer-switch changes assessed here.
disposition.future_fixture_repair: Retain the existing assertions, provide an explicit accepted position for the fixture aircraft, and wait for acknowledged selection before entering the intended edit workflow. Validate that repair in a separate run while retaining this failure report.
